questions.q: What car did the buyers want to purchase?
o: A Fiat 500L from the authorized dealer MSD Trade
questions.e: In the video: "Fiat 500L hteli da kupe preko ovlašćenog Fiatovog dilera, firme MSD Trade iz Obrenovca" — they wanted to buy a Fiat 500L through an authorized Fiat dealer, the firm MSD Trade from Obrenovac.

questions.q: Why did the buyers consider this choice reliable?
o: The state also stands behind the Fiat project
questions.e: In the video: "smatrali da je to sigurna opcija, jer i država stoji iza Fiatovog projekta" — they considered it a safe option, because the state also stands behind the Fiat project.

questions.q: What did the bank do in mid-June 2013?
o: Returned the money to the buyer
Paid the money to the dealer
questions.e: In the video: "Sredinom juna banka je već svoju obavezu ispunila prema dileru" — by mid-June the bank had already fulfilled its obligation to the dealer.

questions.q: What did FAS report in November 2013?
o: That they received no payment from MSD Trade for Branko's car
That the factory is on holiday
That the car has already been shipped
questions.e: In the video: "FAS nije primio nikakvu uplatu od firme MSD Trade u vezi sa kupovinom vozila na ime Branka Simića" — FAS did not receive any payment from the firm MSD Trade in connection with the purchase of a vehicle in the name of Branko Simić.

questions.q: How did the dealer explain the delay?
questions.e: In the video: "razlog za višemesečno odlaganje isporuke to što su ušli u blokadu" — the reason for the months-long delay in delivery is that they went into a blockade.

questions.q: What did the documents on the blockade show?
o: The blockade began only on October 31, two months after the delivery deadline
questions.e: In the video: "MSD Trade je u blokadi tek od 31. oktobra 2013... dva meseca nakon što je istekao rok za isporuku" — MSD Trade has been blocked only since October 31, 2013... two months after the delivery deadline expired.

questions.q: What happened after the first report aired?
questions.e: In the video: "dva dana, bukvalno, posle emitovanja vašeg priloga dobio sam auto" — literally two days after your segment aired, I got the car.

questions.q: What compensation did one of the buyers receive?
o: Warranty extended from two to four years, two service vouchers and 650 euros for the air conditioner
questions.e: In the video: "produžetak garancije sa dve na četiri godine... dva vaučera gratis... povraćaj novca za ugradnju klime, 650 evra" — the warranty extended from two to four years... two free vouchers... a refund for installing the air conditioner, 650 euros.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Za pojedince koji nekako uspeju da sebi *priušte* to zadovoljstvo.
questions.e: Priuštiti sebi — to afford.

questions.q: Fiatovog *ovlašćenog* dilera.
questions.e: Ovlašćen — authorized, official.

questions.q: Ja sam već četiri *rate* uplatio banci.
questions.e: Rata — an installment, a payment by instalments.

questions.q: Neverovatno *kašnjenje* isporuke.
questions.e: Kašnjenje — lateness, a delay; kasniti — to be late.

questions.q: Petoro ljudi koji su *prevareni*.
questions.e: Prevariti — to deceive.

questions.q: Počeo je da smatra da ga je i Fiat *izneverio*.
questions.e: Izneveriti — to let down, to betray trust.

questions.q: Dobio sam *povraćaj* novca za ugradnju klime.
questions.e: Povraćaj — a refund.

questions.q: Stalno pomerao *rok*.
questions.e: Rok — a deadline.

questions.q: Kupovina novog ___ je teško dostižan san.
questions.e: Kupovina of what? Genitive case: novog automobila.

questions.q: Hteli su da kupe Fiat preko ovlašćenog Fiatovog ___.
questions.e: Preko ("through") requires the genitive case: preko dilera.

questions.q: Odluku o kupovini doneo je još tokom ___ 2013.
questions.e: Tokom ("during") requires the genitive case: tokom proleća.

questions.q: Ja sam već četiri ___ uplatio banci.
questions.e: After četiri the form that coincides with the genitive singular is used: četiri rate.

questions.q: Aleksandar se uplašio da će ostati bez ___ i bez automobila.
questions.e: Bez ("without") requires the genitive case: bez novca.

questions.q: Njegov automobil je više meseci stajao u krugu ___.
questions.e: U krugu ("on the premises of") requires the genitive case: u krugu fabrike.

questions.q: Dobio sam dva vaučera gratis za prva dva ___.
questions.e: After dva the genitive singular is used: dva servisa.

questions.q: MSD Trade je bio u blokadi zbog ___ od preko 24 miliona dinara.
questions.e: Zbog ("because of") requires the genitive case: zbog dugovanja.
